purpose: Isolated static-file access training; no CGI or exploit implementation
license_preservation: Base image files, including LICENSE, NOTICE and distribution package notices, are retained. Base OS and dependencies carry their own licenses.

verification.vulnerability_reproduction: not performed by this source-authoring task

notes: CVE-2021-42013 also affects 2.4.49; the two labs compare related path-normalization defects, not unrelated vulnerability classes.
The official checksum sidecars retain an -rc1 archive filename; the published hash value matches the historical packaging metadata.

base_config_digest identifies the registry image configuration only. It must not be assumed equal to docker image inspect .Id on every image store. The deployment operator observed Docker 29.8.1 with a containerd image store reporting a manifest digest as .Id.

Preserve the original compressed layer blobs, config and manifest when importing an OCI archive. A legacy archive with uncompressed layers may produce a different manifest on load. Verify the canonical RepoDigests reference locally before using the pinned amd64 manifest in FROM.

Bare config-digest FROM values are supported only for a verified classic image store/builder whose .Id matches that config digest. Register the newly built derived image's actual Docker-reported .Id in the lab catalog; output_image_id records the completed native inspection on 2026-10-22.
Version environment variables alone are not runtime proof; the Dockerfile compares the executable version during the build and deployment must verify it again.
